ranking_method.source_freshness_note: Retrieval times and HTTP response headers are preserved. The response does not identify a separate metric computation timestamp; HTTP Date is not treated as one. The capture spans several minutes rather than an atomic global snapshot.
ranking_method.display_note: Rankings use FTCScout peak event non-penalty OPR for 2025–26 DECODE, captured October 22, 2026. World and event-region best OPR are shown separately. USIN and USOH rank teams that competed in events assigned those region codes, regardless of home state; they are not home-state rankings. Values display two decimals; JSON and CSV preserve the source numbers.
